prompt.es: Escribe 60–80 palabras sobre el incidente de la feria escolar.

answer.text: Families were visiting the stalls while students were serving drinks at the school fair. A table suddenly lost one leg, and several drinks fell onto the floor. A teacher moved people away from the wet area. The students cleaned the floor and checked the other tables. The school nurse confirmed that nobody was hurt before the fair continued safely with a different table.
accepted: Families were visiting the stalls while students were serving drinks at the school fair. A table suddenly lost one leg, and several drinks fell onto the floor. A teacher moved people away from the wet area. The students cleaned the floor and checked the other tables. The school nurse confirmed that nobody was hurt before the fair continued safely with a different table.

At the school fair, families were visiting stalls and students were serving drinks. One table suddenly broke, so the drinks spilled across the floor. A teacher asked visitors to step back. Students cleaned the area and then checked every other table. The school nurse confirmed that nobody was hurt. Eventually, they replaced the damaged table, and the fair continued without another problem.

feedback.es: El relato extenso incluye contexto doble, rotura, dos reacciones y desenlace.

origin.text: Contexto: familias visitaban puestos; alumnos servían bebidas. Interrupción: mesa perdió una pata y bebidas cayeron. Reacciones: docente apartó personas, alumnos limpiaron, enfermera comprobó que nadie se hirió, revisaron mesas; feria continuó.

prompt.es: Ordena el desenlace posterior a la caída del cartel.

answer.text: Eventually, the staff secured the sign and reopened the entrance.

feedback.es: Eventually introduce el resultado final después de resolver el riesgo.

prompt.es: Escribe 60–80 palabras sobre una avería durante un taller.

answer.text: The group was building shelves while the instructor was demonstrating a drill. The drill suddenly stopped, and everyone noticed a burning smell. The instructor switched off the power and opened the windows. She checked the cable before the session continued. The instructor recorded the fault and removed the drill from the room. Eventually, the group used hand tools and finished the shelf safely.
accepted: The group was building shelves while the instructor was demonstrating a drill. The drill suddenly stopped, and everyone noticed a burning smell. The instructor switched off the power and opened the windows. She checked the cable before the session continued. The instructor recorded the fault and removed the drill from the room. Eventually, the group used hand tools and finished the shelf safely.

During the workshop, participants were building shelves as the instructor demonstrated a drill. The machine stopped and produced a burning smell. The instructor cut the power, and the group opened the windows. After she checked the cable, they continued with hand tools. The instructor recorded the fault and removed the drill from the room. Eventually, they completed one shelf without further trouble.

feedback.es: La recuperación aporta fondo, fallo, medidas de seguridad y resultado final.

origin.text: Contexto: grupo construía estantes; instructor mostraba herramienta. Interrupción: taladro se detuvo y olió a quemado. Reacciones: apagaron corriente, abrieron ventanas, revisaron cable; instructor registró fallo y retiró taladro; usaron herramienta manual.
